purpose: Separate execution completeness, route reachability, content retrieval and evidentiary sufficiency while improving public-source reliability without deleting difficult sources, bypassing access controls or increasing automated pressure on direct voice.

request_policy.accept: application/json, application/xml, text/xml, application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml, text/html;q=0.9, */*;q=0.5

api.gdeltproject.org.reason: The first proven orbit launched twelve simultaneous GDELT requests and received twelve HTTP 429 responses. Basin start times must be deterministically staggered and retries must honor Retry-After.

health_states.execution_complete: Every expected basin emitted a valid artifact and the proof denominator reconciled.
health_states.route_healthy: The route produced either retrievable content or a successful bounded metadata fingerprint.
health_states.content_healthy: The route produced bounded response content suitable for candidate generation.
health_states.coverage_healthy: Global and basin thresholds are met, required source classes have content success and every remaining failure is classified.
health_states.evidence_sufficient: A human adjudication, not the polling system, determines whether retrieved records close a proposition.
